data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) was read from the statement of financial position. The report images supplied did not contain a clearly legible, explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure in the notes that could be unambiguously extracted; therefore no quantified prior year development (gross) is reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as low-resolution images. Opening gross claims outstanding was located on the statement of financial position (Claims outstanding, prior-year comparative) and read as 27,428 (thousands)  27.428 million (USD) but digits are faint and table layout ambiguous so confidence is moderate (0.5). A clear gross prior-year movement (Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) in the notes could not be reliably read from the images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Many other tables (technical provisions note, segmental analysis and movement reconciliation) were partially legible but not sufficiently clear to extract gross PYD, gross premium mix or a claims development triangle without risk of error. If higher-resolution pages or the original PDF are provided I can re-run extraction and populate the missing fields. If only a NET prior-year development is present in the text, that was not used here - no clear gross figure was found.
